entities.name: ERCC2
observations: Somatic ERCC2 mutations were reported in 9/25 cisplatin neoadjuvant chemotherapy responders and 0/25 nonresponders in a retrospective, response-enriched MIBC series (36% vs 0%; Fisher exact P=0.009).

entities.name: Muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma
observations: ERCC2 mutation status was evaluated for association with response to cisplatin-based neoadjuvant chemotherapy.

entities.name: PMID:25096233
observations: Van Allen et al. reported an ERCC2 mutation association with cisplatin sensitivity in a small retrospective MIBC cohort selected across response extremes; this supports candidate biomarker status, not definitive prospective validation.
